nuggets.text: Arch Manning is the grandson of Archie Manning and the nephew of Peyton and Eli Manning, all NFL quarterbacks.
Arch Manning became the first Longhorn ever with a passing, receiving and rushing touchdown in one game, against Arkansas in 2025.
Longhorns coach Steve Sarkisian started at USC as a non-scholarship baseball player before starring at quarterback for BYU.
The Longhorns' 25-22 win at Ohio State in 2005 propelled Vince Young and Texas to the national championship.
Cam Coleman caught two touchdown passes in his Longhorns debut after transferring from Auburn.
Steve Sarkisian played three seasons in the Canadian Football League with the Saskatchewan Roughriders.
Before Bevo, the Longhorns' first mascot was a pit bull terrier named Pig.
Bevo XV broke loose at the 2019 Sugar Bowl and nearly charged Georgia's bulldog mascot.
The Longhorn Band's Big Bertha drum was bought for $1 in 1954 and trucked from Indiana to Austin.
Hollywood Smothers ripped off a 45-yard run on the Longhorns' very first play of the 2026 season.
